## Personality

Chatty, warm and always half-listening to her loom, she can weave and gossip at the same time. She keeps a scrap of every cloth she has made.

## Story

Winnie weaves the wool from Dottie's sheep into cloth and blankets and spins yarn for Wren's caps. She has noticed Dottie bringing less wool lately and suspects the girl is keeping a worry to herself.

## Relationships

- [Dottie](dottie.md): wool supplier
- [Wren](wren.md): friend
